至少要带 Ctrl、Alt、Shift 中的一个: Include at least one of Ctrl, Alt, Shift
要冷启动一次，几分钟，期间这台实例不能用。{how}: It needs one cold start, a few minutes, during which this instance cannot be used. {how}
要几秒：硬件加速检查和 Vulkan 探测: Takes a few seconds: hardware acceleration check and Vulkan probe
要填 {min}–{max} 之间的整数: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}
要填 {min}–{max} 之间的整数（单位 GB）: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max} (in GB)
要用的话在实例的「更多操作」菜单里补全: To use it, add it from the instance's “More actions” menu
要的是 Google 官方的 Google Play 版镜像压缩包 x86_64: Use Google's official Google Play system image archive x86_64-34_r14.zip, or the five files taken out of it.
让{who}把 OpenGL ES 版本报成 3.2（原来是 3.1），Goog: Make {who} report OpenGL ES version 3.2 (it was 3.1), so Google Play no longer treats games that require GLES 3.2 as incompatible.
让{who}把 OpenGL ES 版本改回报 3.1。: Make {who} report OpenGL ES version 3.1 again.
诊断模式已关闭，已清理 {files} 个文件（{bytes}）。: Diagnostics mode is off; {files} file(s) ({bytes}) were cleaned up.
诊断模式已开启，立即生效。: Diagnostics mode is on and takes effect at once.
语言/时区配置无效：{error}: The language/time zone configuration is invalid: {error}
请填写至少一个 HTTP(S) 下载目录。: Enter at least one HTTP(S) download folder.
请手动选中配置信息复制。: Select the configuration info and copy it yourself.
请点下面的「补全组件」打开许可协议并下载，或运行 tools\\modavd.e: Choose “Fetch components” below to open the license agreement and download, or run tools\modavd.exe components fetch.
读不到诊断日志清理范围，请稍后重试: Could not read the diagnostics log cleanup range. Try again later
软件渲染：显卡驱动不可用，游戏会卡: Software rendering: no usable graphics driver, games will lag
还没做（首次开机时做，{time}）: Not done yet (done at the first start, {time})
还没有改回来，可以再关一次: It has not been changed back; you can turn it off again
还没有生效，可以再开一次: It has not taken effect; you can turn it on again
这个文件和 Google 发布的那份不一样（可能没下载完整或被改过），重新下载后: This file differs from the one Google published (it may be incomplete or modified). Download it again and retry.
这个目录现在还不能开机: This folder cannot start instances yet
这个目录现在还不能开机，先按上方提示处理: This folder cannot start instances yet. Follow the notice above first
这个目录现在还不能开机，先按主页上方的提示处理: This folder cannot start instances yet. Follow the notice at the top of the main page first
这个目录还没有商店的五个文件：在下面下载，或者用自己的文件导入，再给实例补全。: This folder does not have the store's five files yet: download them below or import your own, then add the store to the instance.
This manager cannot update itself: shut down all instances and the manager, then run tools\modavd.exe update install. If you use AUTO-MAS you can also update from AUTO-MAS, which uses the update source and CDK in AUTO-MAS settings.
这个键不能用：要数字、字母、F1–F24、小键盘数字或 Home / End 这: This key cannot be used: it must be a digit, letter, F1–F24, numpad digit or a key like Home / End
这个键被别的程序占了，换一个: This key is taken by another program; choose another
连不上 ModAVD 的后台服务: Cannot reach the ModAVD background service
问题包只保存在这台电脑上，不会自动上传。生成以后，这里会写明包里有什么、哪些可以: The problem report is only saved on this computer and is never uploaded automatically. Once it is created, this page says what is inside and what can or must not be shared.
预计可回收空间不足 {threshold}，已跳过重写。磁盘文件占用 {size: Less than {threshold} is expected to be reclaimable, so the rewrite was skipped. The disk file takes {size}.

首次开机会做初始化，约 1⁠–⁠2 分钟: The first start runs initial setup, about 1⁠–⁠2 minutes
